title: Add a milestone to the timeline
description: Add a new entry to `data/milestones.json` for an open-source project you think belongs in the museum. Follow the existing schema — fill in all required fields including `whyItMattered` and `whatItEnabledNext`.

title: Fix a typo in CONTRIBUTING.md
description: Read through `CONTRIBUTING.md` and fix any typo, grammatical error, or unclear sentence you find. Even one word matters — real open-source projects merge doc fixes like this every day.

title: Add a project to the discovery engine
description: Add a beginner-friendly open-source project to `data/discovery.json`. Find a real project on GitHub with `good first issue` labels and add it following the `DiscoveryProject` schema in `src/types/index.ts`.

title: Improve an accessibility label on a component
description: Find a button or interactive element in `src/components/` that is missing an `aria-label` or has a non-descriptive one. Add a meaningful label. Check `src/components/shared/` first — good places to start.

title: Add a missing alt tag to an image
description: Search the codebase for any `` or `` tags missing an `alt` attribute or with `alt=""` that should have a description. Fix it with a meaningful alt text that describes what the image shows.
